mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are 60 degrees near Reddan Soccer Park with clear skies and a Waning Crescent moon. Tonight, the temperature will drop to an overnight low of 49 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona Common Council recently voted unanimously to adopt the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This new long-term roadmap will guide the city's housing, transportation, and sustainability efforts for the next decade.

We have a busy schedule ahead in Verona. Today, you can visit Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy ART House 360, or play trivia at Hop Haus. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.

In a noteworthy update, on October 3, Verona Police officers located a suspect in a stolen firearm case. The 19-year-old was arrested following a traffic stop for expired registration, and the firearm was successfully recovered.

Today's flavor at the Verona Culver's is the delicious Double Strawberry. The restaurant is currently open, and since they are serving until 10:00 PM tonight, there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
